auth.tagline: Learn English for daily life in Singapore.
auth.verifyBody: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. Type it here.
auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.mfaUnsupported: This app cannot do two-step sign-in yet. Please sign in on thelinkproject.org.
auth.forgotBody: Type your email. We will send you a 6-digit code.

account.title: Account
account.deleteFailed: We could not delete your account. Please try again.
account.passwordMinLength: Use at least 8 letters or numbers.
account.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

common.crashBody: The app had a problem. Try again, or close the app and open it again.
common.authUnavailableBody: We could not reach the sign-in service. Check your internet and try again.

foundation.lessonsBody: Tap a lesson to start. Each one takes about 5 minutes.
foundation.emptyBody: New lessons will appear here soon.
foundation.contactBody: Do you have a question for the LINK team?
foundation.sharedAccount: Your profile and password are the same on the LINK website.
foundation.deleteWarning: This deletes your LINK account in the app and on the website. All your data will be removed. You cannot undo this.
foundation.syncError: We could not load your account. Check your internet and try again.
foundation.signOutError: Could not sign out. Please try again.

privacy.accountBody: Clerk keeps your sign-in details safe. The app keeps your account ID, email, username, name and photo link in its own database. It does not keep your password.
privacy.sharedBody: Your login and profile are the same as on the LINK website. What you do in the app is kept separately. The app does not keep your voice recordings or lesson results.
privacy.deleteBody: Deleting your account removes your login and starts removing your data in the app and on the website. The app keeps only a hidden account ID and the date, so old data cannot come back.
privacy.contactHint: Go to Contact us in Account to ask the LINK team about your data.

lessons.buildSentence: Tap the words to make your answer
lessons.tileAdd: Tap to add this word to your answer
lessons.exerciseMissing: This exercise could not be loaded.
lessons.summaryPerfect: You got everything right the first time.
lessons.introBody: Tap a word to hear it. Start when you are ready.

speaking.title: Practise speaking
speaking.intro: A tutor will talk with you in your language. When the tutor asks, say the English out loud.
speaking.privacy: Your voice is sent to Google's Gemini AI so the tutor can hear you. The LINK Project does not keep your recordings.
speaking.data: This uses mobile data. Wi-Fi is best.
speaking.micBlocked: The microphone is off for this app. Turn it on in Settings to practise speaking.
speaking.nothingToPractise: There is nothing to practise speaking in this lesson yet.
speaking.tooShort: That was too short. Speak a little longer.
speaking.tooQuiet: We could not hear you. Hold the phone closer and try again.
speaking.recordFailed: The microphone could not start. Please try again.
speaking.noAudio: No sound for this message. Please read it.
speaking.sendFailed: The tutor could not answer. Check your internet and try again.
speaking.tooMany: Please wait one minute, then try again.

aboutUs.headerDescription: We want English learning to be easy and useful for everyone. Our team works hard to build tools that help migrant workers.
